# live_demo

A minimal local application with a static frontend and a Node.js backend health endpoint.

## Requirements

- Node.js 20 or later

## Run locally

Open two terminals in the repository root.

In the first terminal, start the backend:

```sh
# Generated by GitHub Copilot - Oct-26-2026
npm run dev:backend
```

In the second terminal, start the frontend:

```sh
# Generated by GitHub Copilot - Oct-26-2026
npm run dev:frontend
```

Open http://127.0.0.1:5173. The frontend checks `http://127.0.0.1:3000/health` on load and provides a button to retry the request.

## Test

Run the backend health and HTTP policy checks with:

```sh
# Generated by GitHub Copilot - Oct-26-2026
npm test
```
